tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background and white cards. Dark: the near-black of dark sections and the floating nav.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cool grey section ground and light cards (bento cells, feature panels). Dark: a 5% white wash over canvas.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state on surface; inactive tab pills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dashed chart rules, dividers, hairline card edges.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and solid buttons. On canvas/surface ≥17:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy and descriptions, the slate stat numerals (5.4:1 on white, 4.8:1 on surface; 10:1 on dark canvas).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions and legal over light grounds. Light value is only 3.9:1 on white — use at 18px+ or for non-essential text; dark value 5.4:1.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: THE accent: primary CTA fill, accent words in headlines, active tab, dots, glows. As text on white it is only 2.5:1 (source value) — use it for 48px+ headline words only, and prefer it on dark (7.6:1 on canvas dark).

tokens.name: pink-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed/strong pink; gradient end; scanline dots.

tokens.name: pink-hover
tokens.usage: Pink button hover fill.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text on pink fills (7.5:1). The reference site sets white on pink (2.5:1) — don't; use ink.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: links, icons, chart bars, focus on light (4.7:1 on white). White text on it 4.7:1.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Soft accent ground: tags, highlight cards, selected rows. Ink text on it ≥14:1.

tokens.name: lavender-strong
tokens.usage: Borders and hover on lavender; data bars on light.

tokens.name: mint-light
tokens.usage: Success/positive wash.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Metric tags under stats ("FASTER FIRST REPLY"), positive chips. Ink text ≥15:1.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Live/positive dots and sparkline highlights only — never text.

tokens.name: butter-light
tokens.usage: Notice wash.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Highlighter behind a phrase; warning chips. Ink text ≥17:1.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Attention dots only — never text.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted fill of pills and stat bubbles on photos or pink (with blur-pill and glass-line).

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: 1px edge of frosted glass elements.

tokens.name: glass-clear
tokens.usage: Barely-there glass for big cards over photos (with blur-glass).

tokens.name: glass-clear-line
tokens.usage: 1px edge of clear glass cards.

tokens.name: glass-dark
tokens.usage: Smoked glass chips over photos (with blur-chip); white text on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Top of the photo scrim gradient (transparent ink) — fades to scrim-strong.

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Bottom of the photo scrim gradient behind white text on photography (75% ink).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset — purple on light (4.7:1), pink on dark (7.6:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline over photography, white, bottom-left, max 2 lines. Regular weight — never bold.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: Work every account in one place
styles.usage: Section headlines, right half of a section header; one accent word in pink.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big metrics; ink on light cards, slate in testimonials, with a mono tag under them.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles, bento headlines (with a pink dot before them).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Find the right accounts and reach them while it matters.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE section kicker after a "/" marker, 2 lines max, with the shimmer sweep (text-transform from bundle.css).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Primary nav links in the floating pill.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every touch lands on the right account.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Numbers in tab circles, step counters.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Chips and metric tags, UPPERCASE; names and roles under quotes.

styles.name: rating
styles.usage: Review strip above the hero headline, UPPERCASE.
